-- Task 12 finite current-observed catalog input preparation. NOT EXECUTED.
-- One SELECT; no custom function invocation, business rows or mutations.
-- Governance metadata exceptions authorized by root: allowlisted table
-- classification rows, and migration-ledger count/tail only (no statements).
-- Frontier wave2: 3 new relations and 4 exact signatures from observed delta5dd61d0e.
-- Function definitions additionally include DIRECT triggers of these 3 relations.
-- Dependency records are DIRECT only; referenced functions are not recursed into.
-- Table/function projections below are byte-identical to the prior wave queries.
-- Sequence configuration bigint fields are text; no sequence state is read.
-- Prior report/pins remain frozen. Historical source admission stays BLOCKED.
with named_targets(schema_name,relation_name,test_root) as (values
  ('public','contract_publication_revisions',true),
  ('public','price_plans',true),
  ('public','portfolio_settlement_permission_grants',true)
),
rels as (
  select c.oid,c.relnamespace,c.relname,n.nspname,t.test_root
  from named_targets t
  join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.nspname=t.schema_name
  join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.relnamespace=n.oid and c.relname=t.relation_name
),
expected_functions(signature,profile) as (values
  ('public.gridex_validate_partner_export_payload(text,jsonb)','new'),
  ('public.gridex_bump_contract_publication_revision(uuid,text,text,text)','new'),
  ('public.gridex_portfolio_actor_has_permission(uuid,text,uuid,uuid)','new'),
  ('public.gridex_portfolio_actor_is_superadmin(uuid)','new')
),
objects(classid,objid) as (
  select 'pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass,r.oid from rels r
  union select 'pg_catalog.pg_policy'::regclass,p.oid from pg_catalog.pg_policy p where p.polrelid in(select oid from rels)
  union select 'pg_catalog.pg_attrdef'::regclass,d.oid from pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d where d.adrelid in(select oid from rels)
  union select 'pg_catalog.pg_constraint'::regclass,c.oid from pg_catalog.pg_constraint c where c.conrelid in(select oid from rels)
  union select 'pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass,i.indexrelid from pg_catalog.pg_index i where i.indrelid in(select oid from rels)
  union select 'pg_catalog.pg_rewrite'::regclass,r.oid from pg_catalog.pg_rewrite r where r.ev_class in(select oid from rels)
  union select 'pg_catalog.pg_trigger'::regclass,t.oid from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid in(select oid from rels)
),
deps as (
  select d.* from pg_catalog.pg_depend d join objects o on o.classid=d.classid and o.objid=d.objid
),
function_oids as (
  select pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(signature)::oid oid from expected_functions
  union select t.tgfoid from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid in(select oid from rels where test_root)
),
function_deps as (
  select d.* from pg_catalog.pg_depend d
  where d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::regclass and d.objid in(select oid from function_oids)
),
selected_types as (
  select distinct a.atttypid oid from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
  where a.attrelid in(select oid from rels) and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped
),
root_fks as (
  select f.* from pg_catalog.pg_constraint f
  where f.contype='f' and f.conrelid in(select oid from rels)
),
parent_oids as (select distinct confrelid oid from root_fks),
sequence_oids as (
  select s.oid from pg_catalog.pg_class s
  join pg_catalog.pg_depend d on d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass and d.objid=s.oid
  where s.relkind='S' and d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass and d.refobjid in(select oid from rels)
  union select s.oid from deps d
  join pg_catalog.pg_class s on d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass and d.refobjid=s.oid
  where s.relkind='S'
)
select jsonb_build_object(
 'observed_at', clock_timestamp(),
 'session_context',jsonb_build_object('search_path',current_setting('search_path'),'current_user',current_user,'session_user',session_user,'server_version_num',current_setting('server_version_num')),
 'database', current_database(),
 'server_version', current_setting('server_version'),
 'ledger', (select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'tail',max(version)) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),
 'roles', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',rolname,'superuser',rolsuper,'inherit',rolinherit,'create_role',rolcreaterole,'create_db',rolcreatedb,'login',rolcanlogin,'replication',rolreplication,'bypass_rls',rolbypassrls) order by rolname) from pg_catalog.pg_roles),
 'memberships', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',parent.rolname,'member',child.rolname,'grantor',grantor.rolname,'admin',m.admin_option,'inherit',m.inherit_option,'set',m.set_option) order by parent.rolname,child.rolname), '[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m join pg_catalog.pg_roles parent on parent.oid=m.roleid join pg_catalog.pg_roles child on child.oid=m.member left join pg_catalog.pg_roles grantor on grantor.oid=m.grantor),
 'default_acls', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole),'schema',n.nspname,'object_type',d.defaclobjtype,'acl',d.defaclacl::text) order by pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole),n.nspname,d.defaclobjtype), '[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_default_acl d left join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=d.defaclnamespace),
 'missing_relations',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.schema_name,t.relation_name),'[]'::jsonb) from named_targets t where not exists(select 1 from rels r where r.nspname=t.schema_name and r.relname=t.relation_name)),
 'dependencies',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('object_class',d.classid::regclass::text,'object_oid',d.objid,'object_subid',d.objsubid,'reference_class',d.refclassid::regclass::text,'reference_oid',d.refobjid,'reference_subid',d.refobjsubid,'type',d.deptype,'object',pg_catalog.pg_describe_object(d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid),'reference',pg_catalog.pg_describe_object(d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid)) order by d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid,d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid),'[]'::jsonb) from deps d),
 'types',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',t.oid,'schema',n.nspname,'name',t.typname,'kind',t.typtype,'base_type',t.typbasetype,'not_null',t.typnotnull,'default',t.typdefault,'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner),'acl',t.typacl::text,'enum_labels',(select jsonb_agg(e.enumlabel order by e.enumsortorder) from pg_catalog.pg_enum e where e.enumtypid=t.oid),'domain_constraints',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.conname,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid,true),'validated',c.convalidated) order by c.conname) from pg_catalog.pg_constraint c where c.contypid=t.oid)) order by n.nspname,t.typname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_type t join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=t.typnamespace where t.oid in(select oid from selected_types)),
 'profile', 'BILL03_EVENT_APPLY_NORMAL_PARTNER_PORTFOLIO_CURRENT_OBSERVED_FRONTIER2_V1',
 'history_admission', 'BLOCKED_separate_source_history',
 'named_relations', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',t.schema_name,'name',t.relation_name,'profile',case when t.test_root then 'new' else 'retained' end,'oid',r.oid) order by t.schema_name,t.relation_name) from named_targets t left join rels r on r.nspname=t.schema_name and r.relname=t.relation_name),
 'expected_functions', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',signature,'profile',profile,'oid',pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(signature)::oid) order by signature) from expected_functions),
 'missing_functions', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',signature,'profile',profile) order by signature),'[]'::jsonb) from expected_functions where pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(signature) is null),
 'named_function_overloads',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',p.proname,'identity_arguments',pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'oid',p.oid) order by p.proname,p.oid),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_proc p join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname in ('gridex_validate_partner_export_payload','gridex_bump_contract_publication_revision','gridex_portfolio_actor_has_permission','gridex_portfolio_actor_is_superadmin')),
 'namespaces',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',n.oid,'name',n.nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner),'acl',n.nspacl::text,'access',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'usage',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'USAGE'),'create',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'CREATE')) order by r.rolname) from pg_roles r where r.rolname in('anon','authenticated','service_role','postgres'))) order by n.nspname) from pg_namespace n where n.nspname in('public','private','extensions','auth')),
 'function_dependencies',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('function_oid',d.objid,'reference_class',d.refclassid::regclass::text,'reference_oid',d.refobjid,'reference_subid',d.refobjsubid,'type',d.deptype,'reference',pg_catalog.pg_describe_object(d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid)) order by d.objid,d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid),'[]'::jsonb) from function_deps d),
 'unselected_direct_function_references',(
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',p.oid,'schema',n.nspname,'name',p.proname,'identity_arguments',pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)) order by n.nspname,p.proname,p.oid),'[]'::jsonb)
  from pg_catalog.pg_proc p join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
  where p.oid in(
    select d.refobjid from deps d where d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::regclass
    union select d.refobjid from function_deps d where d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::regclass
  ) and not exists(select 1 from function_oids f where f.oid=p.oid)
),
 'root_foreign_keys',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',f.oid,'name',f.conname,'child',f.conrelid::regclass::text,'parent',f.confrelid::regclass::text,'parent_oid',f.confrelid,'child_columns',f.conkey,'parent_columns',f.confkey,'index_oid',f.conindid,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(f.oid,true),'validated',f.convalidated,'deferrable',f.condeferrable,'deferred',f.condeferred,'delete_action',f.confdeltype,'update_action',f.confupdtype,'match_type',f.confmatchtype) order by f.conrelid,f.conname),'[]'::jsonb) from root_fks f),
 'parent_key_projections',(
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',c.relname,'oid',c.oid,'kind',c.relkind,'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'acl',c.relacl::text,'namespace_acl',n.nspacl::text,
    'columns',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('number',a.attnum,'name',a.attname,'type_oid',a.atttypid,'type',pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'collation_oid',a.attcollation,'acl',a.attacl::text) order by a.attnum) from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a where a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum=any(array(select unnest(f.confkey) from root_fks f where f.confrelid=c.oid))),
    'referenced_indexes',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',i.indexrelid,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),'unique',i.indisunique,'primary',i.indisprimary,'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready,'nulls_not_distinct',i.indnullsnotdistinct,'key_columns',i.indkey::text,'key_count',i.indnkeyatts,'total_count',i.indnatts,
      'opclasses',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('position',o.pos,'oid',o.oid,'schema',onsp.nspname,'name',oc.opcname,'family_oid',oc.opcfamily,'input_type',oc.opcintype,'default',oc.opcdefault) order by o.pos) from unnest(i.indclass::oid[]) with ordinality o(oid,pos) join pg_catalog.pg_opclass oc on oc.oid=o.oid join pg_catalog.pg_namespace onsp on onsp.oid=oc.opcnamespace),
      'collations',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('position',co.pos,'oid',co.oid,'metadata',to_jsonb(pc)) order by co.pos) from unnest(i.indcollation::oid[]) with ordinality co(oid,pos) left join pg_catalog.pg_collation pc on pc.oid=co.oid),
      'predicate',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indpred,i.indrelid),'expressions',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indexprs,i.indrelid),
      'constraints',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',uc.oid,'name',uc.conname,'type',uc.contype,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(uc.oid,true),'validated',uc.convalidated,'deferrable',uc.condeferrable,'deferred',uc.condeferred) order by uc.oid) from pg_catalog.pg_constraint uc where uc.conrelid=c.oid and uc.conindid=i.indexrelid)
    ) order by i.indexrelid) from pg_catalog.pg_index i where i.indrelid=c.oid and i.indexrelid in(select f.conindid from root_fks f where f.confrelid=c.oid))
  ) order by n.nspname,c.relname),'[]'::jsonb)
  from parent_oids po join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid=po.oid join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
),

 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',s.oid,'schema',n.nspname,'name',s.relname,'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(s.relowner),'acl',s.relacl::text,
   'configuration',jsonb_build_object('seqrelid',cfg.seqrelid::text,'seqtypid',cfg.seqtypid::text,'seqstart',cfg.seqstart::text,'seqincrement',cfg.seqincrement::text,'seqmax',cfg.seqmax::text,'seqmin',cfg.seqmin::text,'seqcache',cfg.seqcache::text,'seqcycle',cfg.seqcycle),
   'configuration_encoding','integer_config_as_text_no_counter_state',

   'dependencies',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('class',d.refclassid::regclass::text,'oid',d.refobjid,'subid',d.refobjsubid,'type',d.deptype,'reference',pg_catalog.pg_describe_object(d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid)) order by d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.refobjsubid) from pg_catalog.pg_depend d where d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass and d.objid=s.oid)
 ) order by n.nspname,s.relname),'[]'::jsonb)
 from pg_catalog.pg_class s join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=s.relnamespace
 join pg_catalog.pg_sequence cfg on cfg.seqrelid=s.oid where s.oid in(select oid from sequence_oids)
),
 'index_details',(
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table_oid',i.indrelid,'index_oid',i.indexrelid,'name',c.relname,'live',i.indislive,'key_columns',i.indkey::text,'key_count',i.indnkeyatts,'total_count',i.indnatts,'opclass_oids',i.indclass::text,'collation_oids',i.indcollation::text,'options',i.indoption::text) order by i.indrelid,i.indexrelid),'[]'::jsonb)
 from pg_catalog.pg_index i join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid=i.indexrelid where i.indrelid in(select oid from rels)
),

 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table_oid',t.tgrelid,'trigger_oid',t.oid,'function_oid',t.tgfoid,'event_bits',t.tgtype,'update_columns',t.tgattr::text,'argument_count',t.tgnargs,'arguments_hex',encode(t.tgargs,'hex'),'qual_node_tree',t.tgqual::text) order by t.tgrelid,t.tgname),'[]'::jsonb)
 from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid in(select oid from rels)
),
 'functions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',p.oid,'schema',n.nspname,'name',p.proname,'identity_arguments',pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'result',pg_catalog.pg_get_function_result(p.oid),'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'acl',p.proacl::text,'language',l.lanname,'kind',p.prokind,'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile,'strict',p.proisstrict,'parallel',p.proparallel,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'config',p.proconfig,'definition',case when n.nspname<>'pg_catalog' and p.prokind in('f','p') then pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) else null end,'effective_execute',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'execute',has_function_privilege(r.oid,p.oid,'EXECUTE')) order by r.rolname) from pg_catalog.pg_roles r where r.rolname in('anon','authenticated','service_role','postgres')),'extension',(select jsonb_build_object('name',e.extname,'version',e.extversion) from pg_catalog.pg_depend d join pg_catalog.pg_extension e on e.oid=d.refobjid and d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_extension'::regclass where d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::regclass and d.objid=p.oid and d.deptype='e')) order by n.nspname,p.proname,p.oid),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_proc p join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace join pg_catalog.pg_language l on l.oid=p.prolang where p.oid in(select oid from function_oids)),
 'tables', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',c.relname,'kind',c.relkind,'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',c.relforcerowsecurity,'acl',c.relacl::text,
   'policies',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.polname,'command',p.polcmd,'permissive',p.polpermissive,'roles',(select jsonb_agg(case when r.oid=0 then 'PUBLIC' else pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(r.oid) end order by r.oid) from unnest(p.polroles) as r(oid)),'using',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid),'with_check',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid)) order by p.polname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_policy p where p.polrelid=c.oid),
   'classification',(select to_jsonb(t) from public.platform_table_classification t where t.table_name=c.relname),
   'oid',c.oid,'schema_owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner),'schema_acl',n.nspacl::text,'options',c.reloptions,'view_definition',case when c.relkind in('v','m') then pg_catalog.pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,true) else null end,
   'columns',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('number',a.attnum,'name',a.attname,'type_oid',a.atttypid,'type',pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'identity',a.attidentity,'generated',a.attgenerated,'inherited_count',a.attinhcount,'is_local',a.attislocal,'collation_oid',a.attcollation,'default',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),'acl',a.attacl::text) order by a.attnum),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a left join pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid=a.attrelid and d.adnum=a.attnum where a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped),
   'constraints',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',f.oid,'name',f.conname,'type',f.contype,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(f.oid,true),'validated',f.convalidated,'deferrable',f.condeferrable,'deferred',f.condeferred,'columns',f.conkey,'parent',case when f.confrelid<>0 then f.confrelid::regclass::text else null end,'parent_oid',f.confrelid,'parent_columns',f.confkey,'parent_key_metadata',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('number',a.attnum,'name',a.attname,'type',pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull) order by a.attnum) from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a where a.attrelid=f.confrelid and a.attnum=any(f.confkey)),'delete_action',f.confdeltype,'update_action',f.confupdtype,'match_type',f.confmatchtype,'index_oid',f.conindid) order by f.conname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_constraint f where f.conrelid=c.oid),
   'indexes',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',i.indexrelid,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),'unique',i.indisunique,'primary',i.indisprimary,'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready,'nulls_not_distinct',i.indnullsnotdistinct,'predicate',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indpred,i.indrelid),'expressions',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indexprs,i.indrelid)) order by i.indexrelid),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_index i where i.indrelid=c.oid),
   'triggers',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',t.oid,'name',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'internal',t.tgisinternal,'function_oid',t.tgfoid,'constraint_oid',t.tgconstraint,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true)) order by t.tgname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid=c.oid),
   'rules',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',r.oid,'name',r.rulename,'event',r.ev_type,'enabled',r.ev_enabled,'instead',r.is_instead,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_ruledef(r.oid,true)) order by r.rulename),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_catalog.pg_rewrite r where r.ev_class=c.oid),

   'effective_access',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'select',has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'SELECT'),'insert',has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'INSERT'),'update',has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'UPDATE'),'delete',has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'DELETE'),'schema_usage',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'USAGE')) order by r.rolname) from pg_catalog.pg_roles r where r.rolname in ('anon','authenticated','service_role'))
 ) order by c.relname) from pg_catalog.pg_class c join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where c.oid in(select oid from rels))

functions.name: gridex_bump_contract_publication_revision
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gridex_bump_contract_publication_revision(p_company_id uuid, p_channel text, p_reason text, p_entity_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  r public.contract_publication_revisions%rowtype;
  v_event_id uuid;
  v_tenant_reference text;
  v_event_data jsonb;
  v_occurred_at timestamptz:=now();
begin
  if p_company_id is null or p_channel not in ('website','api','internal','phone','partner') then
    raise exception using errcode='22023',message='publication_revision_scope_invalid';
  end if;

  select external_tenant_reference into v_tenant_reference
  from public.companies where id=p_company_id;
  if v_tenant_reference is null then
    raise exception using errcode='23502',message='external_tenant_reference_missing';
  end if;

  insert into public.contract_publication_revisions(company_id,channel,revision,revision_token,updated_at)
  values(p_company_id,p_channel,1,gen_random_uuid(),v_occurred_at)
  on conflict(company_id,channel) do update set
    revision=public.contract_publication_revisions.revision+1,
    revision_token=gen_random_uuid(),
    updated_at=v_occurred_at
  returning * into r;

  v_event_data:=jsonb_build_object(
    'tenant_reference',v_tenant_reference,
    'channel',p_channel,
    'publication_revision',r.revision,
    'revision_token',r.revision_token,
    'reason',p_reason,
    'timestamp',r.updated_at
  );

  insert into public.domain_events(
    company_id,event_type,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,source,idempotency_key,payload,occurred_at
  ) values(
    p_company_id,'contracts.publication.changed','contract_publication',
    coalesce(p_entity_id,'publication:'||p_channel),'database',
    format('contracts.publication.changed:%s:%s:%s',p_company_id,p_channel,r.revision),
    v_event_data,v_occurred_at
  ) on conflict(idempotency_key) where idempotency_key is not null do nothing
  returning id into v_event_id;

  if v_event_id is not null then
    insert into public.webhook_deliveries(
      company_id,webhook_subscription_id,domain_event_id,event_type,
      max_attempts,target_url,idempotency_key,payload
    )
    select
      p_company_id,ws.id,v_event_id,'contracts.publication.changed',
      ws.max_attempts,ws.endpoint_url,
      format('webhook:%s:%s',ws.id,v_event_id),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id',v_event_id,
        'type','contracts.publication.changed',
        'event_id',v_event_id,
        'event_type','contracts.publication.changed',
        'created_at',v_occurred_at,
        'tenant_reference',v_tenant_reference,
        'environment',null,
        'customer_id',null,
        'customer_number',null,
        'external_customer_id',null,
        'aggregate',jsonb_build_object(
          'type','contract_publication',
          'id',coalesce(p_entity_id,'publication:'||p_channel)
        ),
        'data',v_event_data
      )
    from public.webhook_subscriptions ws
    where ws.company_id=p_company_id
      and ws.status='active'
      and ('*'=any(coalesce(ws.event_types,'{}'::text[]))
           or 'contracts.publication.changed'=any(coalesce(ws.event_types,'{}'::text[])))
    on conflict(idempotency_key) do nothing;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'tenant_reference',v_tenant_reference,
    'channel',r.channel,
    'revision',r.revision,
    'revision_token',r.revision_token,
    'updated_at',r.updated_at,
    'event_id',v_event_id
  );
end $function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_company_id uuid, p_channel text, p_reason text, p_entity_id text

functions.name: gridex_portfolio_actor_has_permission
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gridex_portfolio_actor_has_permission(p_actor_user_id uuid, p_permission text, p_company_id uuid, p_portfolio_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select (coalesce(auth.role(),'')='service_role' or p_actor_user_id=auth.uid())
  and (public.gridex_portfolio_actor_is_superadmin(p_actor_user_id)
  or (
    p_permission<>'portfolio_settlement.manage_access'
    and exists(
      select 1 from public.portfolio_settlement_permission_grants g
      where g.user_id=p_actor_user_id
        and g.permission=p_permission
        and g.company_id=p_company_id
        and (g.portfolio_id is null or g.portfolio_id=p_portfolio_id)
        and g.revoked_at is null
        and g.valid_from<=now()
        and (g.expires_at is null or g.expires_at>now())
    )
  ))
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_actor_user_id uuid, p_permission text, p_company_id uuid, p_portfolio_id uuid

functions.name: gridex_portfolio_actor_is_superadmin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gridex_portfolio_actor_is_superadmin(p_actor_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select p_actor_user_id is not null
  and (coalesce(auth.role(), '') = 'service_role' or p_actor_user_id = auth.uid())
  and (
    exists (
      select 1
      from public.admin_users au
      where au.user_id = p_actor_user_id
        and coalesce(au.is_active, true)
        and lower(coalesce(au.role, '')) in ('super_admin', 'platform_superadmin')
    )
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.user_roles ur
      left join public.roles r on r.id = ur.role_id
      where ur.user_id = p_actor_user_id
        and coalesce(ur.status, 'active') = 'active'
        and coalesce(ur.is_active, true)
        and lower(coalesce(ur.role, r.key, r.name, '')) in ('super_admin', 'platform_superadmin')
    )
  )
$function$
